questions.question: Why was a replacement invoice raised for ACME Trading?

required.fact: the units arrived damaged on delivery — the CAUSE
the replacement invoice that was issued — the CONSEQUENCE

questions.note: The canonical two-hop question. Retrieving only the invoice yields 'a replacement was issued' with no reason; retrieving only the ticket yields a complaint with no resolution. Either half alone reads as a complete answer, which is exactly why nDCG cannot see the failure.

questions.question: What is holding up the Jebel Ali shipment and what is still outstanding?

required.fact: the shipment is held at customs pending documentation
the follow-up recording that the documentation is still missing

questions.note: Two tickets on one incident. Answering from the first alone reports a problem that has since progressed.

questions.question: When does the Zenith freight contract renew, and on what terms?

required.fact: the account record stating the contract renews annually each March
the note stating rates are fixed for twelve months

questions.note: The date and the terms live in different records. An answer with the date and not the rates is the failure mode a completion-rate gate catches and a mean does not.

questions.question: Who handles procurement at ACME Trading and what do they buy?
Which supplier provides stationery, and what was last ordered?
How are ACME Trading and ACME Holdings related?

required.fact: the parent, and the free-zone registration

questions.note: A relationship question: neither record alone states the relationship usefully.

questions.question: من هو مندوب المبيعات في شركة السلام وما نشاط الشركة؟

required.fact: نشاط الشركة: نقل بري بين المدن

questions.note: The Arabic two-hop case. Arabic coverage is not a translation of the English cases: an engine can pass every English coverage question and fail every Arabic one, because the step that breaks (normalization) is upstream of retrieval entirely.

questions.question: ما الذي وردته شركة المها ومن هو مسؤول المشتريات لديها؟
questions.note: Three documents in Arabic. A three-fact set is where mean coverage flatters most — two of three is 0.67 and a completely wrong answer.

questions.question: ما هي أعمال الصيانة المطلوبة والفواتير المرتبطة بها؟
What does Meridian Private Holdings pay, and how often?
questions.note: A question whose evidence the caller may not see. The REQUIRED outcome is 'unanswerable', not a partial answer: an agent that answers from the fragment it could reach is worse than one that refuses, because the user cannot tell the difference between a complete answer and a confidently incomplete one. Retrieval enforcing permissions is only half the property — this is the other half.

questions.question: What is our policy on cryptocurrency payments?
questions.note: Nothing in the corpus is about this. The façade must abstain — an empty result set is a CORRECT answer when it is true, and a retrieval system that never says 'I don't know' has not been tested for the failure that matters most.

questions.question: When does the ACME Trading contract expire?
questions.note: The HARD one: every term is in the corpus, so retrieval returns plausible, well-ranked, high-scoring rows — the ACME account, its invoices, the Zenith renewal note. None answers the question. This is precisely where a confident wrong answer comes from, and it is invisible to nDCG because the returned rows genuinely are relevant to the words.

questions.question: ما هي سياسة العمل عن بعد؟
questions.note: Arabic. Abstention tested in one language only is abstention that fails silently in the other.
